prompt:
You match supplier price-list items to a product catalog.
Decide which catalog candidate, if any, is exactly the same product as the price-list item.
Rules:
- The same product has the same brand and the same model number. Differences in colour,
  capacity, size or bundle contents (when they change the model number) mean a different product.
- Ignore wording differences, marketing text and price differences.
- If no candidate is clearly the same product, answer "none". Do not guess.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"choice": <number 1..N or "none">, "confidence": <0.0..1.0>, "reason": "<short sentence>"}

Price-list item:
name: Sanus Silver LCD Television Turntable - TVLCDS; brand: sanus; description: Sanus Silver LCD Television Turntable - TVLCDS/ Holds 13'-30' Size Televisions/ 360 Degree Rotation/ Silver Finish; price: $29.99

Candidates:
1. name: Sanus Television Turntable - TV/LCDS; brand: Sanus; description: 150 lb
2. name: Sanus Wall/Ceiling Speaker Mount - WMS3S SILVER; brand: Sanus; description: Plastic - 8 lb
3. name: Sanus Flat Panel TV Wall Mount - VM400B; brand: Sanus; description: Steel, Aluminum - 80 lb

response.text: {"choice": "none", "confidence": 1.0, "reason": "No candidate matches the model number TVLCDS exactly."}
